skills.question-requirements: Clarifies and cuts large server changes before they are built.
skills.vision: Keeps the purpose and limits of the server in VISION.md.
skills.prove-change: Guides real config replay, benchmarks and VM checks with the server tools.

evals.evals/baseline.tsv: Holds the limits for deploy bytes, second install time and error rate.
evals.evals/bench.sh: Measures the real deploy payload and the VM results.
evals.evals/conf-keys.sh: Guards the allowed local config formats.
evals.evals/intent-lib.sh: Helpers for the intent scripts that stay.
evals.evals/intent/expiry-warns-only.sh: Keeps an expired date a warning only.
evals.evals/intent/expiry.sh: Checks that EXPIRY is a date three months out.
evals.evals/intent/gate-ignores-expiry.sh: Keeps the gate on warning only for a late date.
evals.evals/intent/needs-consistency.sh: Keeps project.needs.json equal to the skills, evals and tools in the repo.
evals.evals/intent/server-bench-local.sh: Runs the benchmark of the real payload.
evals.evals/keep.awk: Keeps the replay aligned with the accepted removals.
evals.evals/lib.sh: Shared helpers for the server evals.
evals.evals/lint.tsv: Lists the seven shell scanner cases.
evals.evals/lint/fixtures/sh/suppress.sh: Pins the no disabled checks rule.
evals.evals/removed-paths: Guards the paths the author removed.
evals.evals/replay.sh: Compares the real configs with the golden files.
evals.evals/secrets-detect.sh: Checks that secret scanning finds the WireGuard and SRS keys.
evals.evals/trace.sh: Checks that ids are unique and each has an eval.
evals.evals/vm-retire.sh: Checks old access is retired, files stay and WireGuard is intact.
evals.evals/vm-wkd.sh: Keeps both OpenPGP lookup methods and the known gap.
evals.evals/vm.sh: Checks installs, keys, modes, services and WireGuard on the VM.

tools.bashInteractive: Runs the gate, the scanner and the evals.
tools.git: Lists the files the scanner and the gate check.
tools.gnutar: Packs the deploy payload that evals/bench.sh measures.
tools.shellcheck: Checks every shell file in the gate.
